editorial_sense: A forest poetically keeps secret information; this is an inanimate-actor personification of gëzhezha. A storyteller withholding information is a possible literary gloss, not a verified stock idiom.
no_world_entailment: No trees are said to have thoughts in the actual world.

metaphor: the clock argued with the silence
editorial_sense: Personify clock as disputant and silence as comitative interlocutor; tense quiet atmosphere can be the suggested interpretation.
no_world_entailment: No literal audible speech by a clock is asserted.

metaphor: the river carried a thousand memories
p: kimaro moru-ri-m zhu zhewawa dë zhewa zhu zhe zhu qaruwo-te
editorial_sense: Exactly one thousand decimal memories expressed as 4×216+3×36+4×6+4 in written base-six place terms; new metaphorical transport of memories by a river.
no_world_entailment: River water is not said to possess human memory in the physical world.

editorial_sense: The town as collective metonym holds its breath; the figurative sense refers to collective anticipation, not the residents literally suspending respiration.
no_world_entailment: Neither widespread cessation of breathing nor death is implied.

editorial_sense: Mountain personification uses a refusal-to-move content frame; the mountain merely appears unwilling to move to the reader, no agency or volition is established.
no_world_entailment: Rock literally making a conscious resistance decision is not asserted.

metaphor: the old house remembered every winter
editorial_sense: Old house is a personified subject of remembering. ngënao distributes over every winter, not the house itself.
no_world_entailment: No house is said to be sentient.

editorial_sense: A traveled road personified as forgetting people who traveled it. gura-mi-ri explicitly refers to traveling people; road is not an animate memory-holder.
no_world_entailment: Neither literal pavement amnesia nor lost official records is implied.
